theme: Community health care and emergency services related deaths

reports.title: Caroline Robey
categories: Community health care and emergency services related deaths

promises.quote: In March 2015 EMAS introduced an updated sepsis screening tool (both adult and paediatric) based upon the Sepsis 6 red flags and NHS England Safety Alert (2014) (appendices 1a and 1b).
promises.summary: Introduced updated sepsis screening tool based on Sepsis 6 and NHS England Safety Alert (2014).

promises.quote: A patient safety alert was issued on the 2 September 2014 by NHS England clearly sets out the resources available in the provision of a UK Sepsis clinical tool kit, but this has not be recognised or adopted by health care providers in this case.
promises.summary: Will develop approved system to review and implement patient safety alerts by January 2016.

promises.quote: Inadequate note was made of the number of different attendances Mrs Robey had initiated despite previous good health, and there is no suggestion that she was a frequent attender or had ever sort medical attention inappropriately.
promises.summary: No specific action identified; concern remains unaddressed.

promises.quote: The PAG considered the case and concluded that the following actions should be undertaken: - has been requested to reflect on his record keeping at his next appraisal and on the diagnosis and treatment of patients with suspected sepsis.
promises.summary: request reflection on record keeping and sepsis diagnosis at next appraisal

concerns.quote: No sepsis screening tool was being used by the community health care providers, and so opportunities were lost to consider a diagnosis of sepsis and refer as an emergency for hospital admission and treatment

Apatient safety alert issued 2 September 2014 by NHS England clearly sets out resources available in the provision of a UK sepsis clinical tool kit, but this had not been recognised or adopted by the health care providers involved in this case.
concerns.hazard: non adoption of patient safety alert

concerns.quote: Inadequate note was taken of the number of different attendances Mrs Robey had initiated despite previous good health, and there was no suggestion she was a frequent attender or had ever sought medical assistance inappropriately

reports.title: Edward Jones: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: there is no Sepsis Screening Tool which is validated for use in Paediatric Emergency Departments or has a sensitivity or specificity which makes it a useful tool for escalation within a Paediatric Emergency Department
concerns.hazard: lack of validated paediatric sepsis screening tool

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of a sepsis screening tool that could help identify sepsis early. The earlier report concerns community healthcare providers, while the later report concerns paediatric emergency departments.
links.earlier_quote: No sepsis screening tool was being used by the community health care providers, and so opportunities were lost to consider a diagnosis of sepsis and refer as an emergency for hospital admission and treatment
links.later_quote: there is no Sepsis Screening Tool which is validated for use in Paediatric Emergency Departments or has a sensitivity or specificity which makes it a useful tool for escalation within a Paediatric Emergency Department.
